name: Bright Fuzz
description: The tone well over to the treble: a cutting fuzz that sits on top of a band.

name: Doom Bass
description: The tone dark, for bass or tuned-down riffs: all low end and grind, at full quality.

name: Gritty Rhythm
description: The sustain low: a rough, open fuzz that keeps chords apart.

name: Singing Lead
description: Full sustain, the tone a little bright: a note that sings and hangs.

name: Wall of Fuzz
description: The sustain up and the tone at noon: the thick, smooth wall with the scooped middle.
